npcs.name: Captain Thorne Ironhelm
npcs.appearance: A grizzled man in dented plate armor stands behind a wooden desk.
npcs.greeting: Well met. If you're seeking work, you've come at the right time. Dark times are falling on Millhaven.

keywords.quest: The roads are unsafe. Caravans vanish, and young Elara Whitmore was taken three days ago.
keywords.elara: Sweet child. Disappeared from her farm. Her mother Marta is beside herself. Fifty gold if you find her.
keywords.creatures: Farmers speak of shadows moving. Animals found dead, or worse... corrupted. Brother Aldus believes it's dark magic.

npcs.name: Queen Liora
npcs.appearance: A strikingly beautiful woman in royal silks with a perfectly practiced, cold smile.
npcs.greeting: Ah, the heroes of Millhaven. How quaint. Perhaps you might join us for wine?

keywords.king: The King is adjusting to recent pressures. His paranoia is tiresome, but I remain steadfast.
keywords.covenant: Ah, you know. How delightful. We are not murderers, we are gravediggers for a dead world.
keywords.corruption: Such an ugly word. I call it 'transformation.' The shadow will purge the weak.

npcs.name: Malachai Vex
npcs.appearance: A tall, aristocratic man radiating magnetic charisma and faint, unsettling shadow.
npcs.greeting: At last we meet. Sit with me. Let us discuss the world as it truly is.

keywords.vision: The old order is a fossil. We will be perfected through the shadow.
keywords.shadow: Shadow is entropy—the natural force of ending. It grants clarity and power.
keywords.ascension: I am a Vessel. Soon, I will be consumed, and the true god will wear this flesh.
